    New Campaign
    Printed in the header band of every slide.

    Slide artwork

    Sets the layout and the slide wording. The four built-ins are the styles article carousels use; make your own to change the labels, the disclaimer or the button text.

    Portrait 4:5 works best. A stock photo keeps its photographer credit.

    Resized and compressed in the browser so it fits the record. JPG, PNG or WebP.

    Call to action
    What changes each time
    One row per occurrence. Add a header row naming the columns (headline, subhead, point1, point1body, update, note, ctaLink) and each column fills that field on the artwork exactly as written. Without a header, column 1 is the message and column 2 the call to action.

    Token Usage
    OpenRouter token consumption — total, last 28 days, last 24 hours, last hour. Recorded across automation runs, AI revisions, and every in-app generator, for every user.
    Loading…
    A/B Test — Models
    Route a percentage of automation generations to alternative models. Outcomes (success/failure) and cost-per-successful-generation surface below so you can compare effective economics, not just sticker price.

    Need at least 2 variants for the test to be active. Weight controls relative traffic share — higher = picked more often.

    No A/B data yet.
    Master Prompt (Golden Rules)
    Prepended to every LLM generation — automation and in-browser. Single source of truth for brand identity and global style rules (em-dash ban, UK English, omega-3, etc.). Edit once, applies everywhere.

    Tip: keep this short and behaviour-focused. Category prompts handle structure and length; this is for cross-category rules that should never be broken.

    Hero Image Prompts
    The prompt that drives AI hero image generation — for the in-app generator and automated runs. Use {topic} where the article subject should be inserted. Set a per-category override on the Categories page; this is the global default plus a reusable preset library.

    Reusable hero prompts you can apply to any category from the category editor. Editing a preset here does not retroactively change categories already using its text.

    Which service supplies photos for categories whose Hero Image source is set to Stock Photo — in the generator and automation.

    Create a free app at unsplash.com/developers and paste its Access Key here. Required for Unsplash search.
